title: Chemical formula — count atoms → molecular weight → validation
label: ag-multi
statement: A chemical formula is a sequence of elements (an uppercase letter followed by lowercase letters, e.g. `H`, `Mg`) and parenthesised groups, each optionally followed by a count (`H2O`, `Mg(OH)2`, `K4(ON(SO3)2)2`). Return the **count of every atom** as a string: elements in alphabetical order, each followed by its count when the count is above 1. `Mg(OH)2` → `H2MgO2`.
provenance: "Chemical formula weight" is reported in an Agoda phone screen (Sep 2026, FastPrep) and as "compute chemical formula weight" in an SSE Gurugram round (Oct 2025, codingkaro); LeetCode 726 Number of Atoms scores 91.8% for Agoda on CodeJeet. The exact Agoda statement was not given; stage 1 is LeetCode 726, stage 2 the reported weight, in my words.

stages.title: Count the atoms
stages.say: Given a chemical formula, return the count of every atom.

stages.title: Molecular weight
stages.say: The product actually needs the molecular weight. Given a table of atomic masses, compute it.
stages.require: Add `Formula.Weight(formula, masses)` returning double; an element missing from the table → `ArgumentException`.

stages.title: Bad input and deep nesting
stages.say: This parses user input. Reject malformed formulas, and make sure a hostile one cannot crash the service.
stages.require: Malformed input → `FormatException` (unbalanced parentheses, lowercase start, count 0 or leading zero, empty group, stray characters). 20,000 nested groups must not overflow the stack.

learn.title: 1 · Problem
learn.md: A chemical formula is a sequence of elements (an uppercase letter followed by lowercase letters, e.g. `H`, `Mg`) and parenthesised groups, each optionally followed by a count (`H2O`, `Mg(OH)2`, `K4(ON(SO3)2)2`). Return the **count of every atom** as a string: elements in alphabetical order, each followed by its count when the count is above 1. `Mg(OH)2` → `H2MgO2`.

learn.title: 2 · Clarifications
learn.md:
- Can groups nest? (Yes, arbitrarily.)
- Can a count be 0 or have a leading zero? (No — reject.)
- How should invalid input be reported? (FormatException.)
- Can counts overflow int? (Use long, checked.)

learn.title: 3 · Key insight
learn.md: A group's count multiplies everything inside it, and groups nest — exactly what a stack models. Each "(" opens a fresh map; each ")" closes it, multiplies it, and folds it into the enclosing map. The element order only matters at output time, so sort once at the end.

learn.title: 4 · Approach
learn.md: I would say, before coding: "A." stack of count maps handles nesting — push on "(", and on ")" multiply the popped map by the following count and merge it into the map below — which parses the whole formula in one left-to-right pass."

learn.title: 11 · AI usage strategy

- Delegate the mechanical parts only after the structure is fixed.

Review my reasoning without giving me the implementation. What would break it?"

learn.title: 12 · Common AI mistakes
learn.md:
- Recursion on deeply nested input — stack overflow.
- Reading a two-letter element as two elements (Mg → M, g).
- Forgetting that a count follows ")" as well as an element.
- Sorting with culture-aware comparison instead of ordinal.
- Accepting "H0" or "()".
